infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Offline Connect Pro discovers nearby phones and exchanges messages, files and calls over your local Wi-Fi network.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Camera access is used for local video calls.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Microphone access is used for local voice and video calls.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Offline Connect Pro to use the camera during local video calls.
plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Offline Connect Pro to use the microphone during local calls.
